notes.ttv: time to first violation (pair gap < 0) of the buffered footprint along the chosen plan over the enforced tracks, 16 check times to 4 s, clipped at 4 s; shares over the decisions with an enforced track (D14 v04 A5)
notes.ttv_enf: the same over the enforced pairs only within 2 s (the exempt C8 pairs skipped there) and every check time after 2 s: the part a speed choice could act on; ttv - ttv_enf isolates the exempt conflicts
notes.ttc_proxy_v01: v01's TTC proxy, secondary (R15 M1: not a time to collision)
notes.ttv_share_lt_2s: arm-invariant by construction (R15b N3): within the 2 s enforcement horizon every enforced pair keeps gap >= margin >= 0 on the tracks' predicted means, so what remains are the exempt (C8) conflicts, identical for every arm; TTV < 4 s and ttv_enf are the secondary safety reading, V2_viol leads
notes.divergence_share: decision mode: a hard-braking indicator (R15 m10); replay divergence is read from loop mode

covariance_by_arm.B6: A (S_h + sigma_a^2 I) A, A = (c_long / z) a_l a_l' + (c_lat / z) a_t a_t', thresholds B6_ip(L0, in-path) (no motion strata)

safety_reading.order: R15b N3 / D14 v05 section 4: the decision-mode safety headline is V2_viol (ground truth: a relied constraint actually violated at the plan, D > G), per population and paired against M*; TTV < 4 s and ttv_enf are secondary; ttv_share_lt_2s is kept, labelled arm-invariant by construction (R15b N3)
safety_reading.headline_V2_viol_definition: per decision, any relied constraint over the 4 annotated calibrated steps actually violated at the chosen plan's pose (D > G: ground truth, not a coverage rate); scene-level share of the decisions with a relied record, log-cluster bootstrap interval

ttv_share_lt_2s.label: arm-invariant by construction (R15b N3)
ttv_share_lt_2s.why: arm-invariant by construction (R15b N3): within the 2 s enforcement horizon every enforced pair keeps gap >= margin >= 0 on the tracks' predicted means, so what remains are the exempt (C8) conflicts, identical for every arm; TTV < 4 s and ttv_enf are the secondary safety reading, V2_viol leads

sweep.reading: one curve: alpha arms at alpha, delta' arms at alpha_eq; RETUNED = the cross-fitted least conservative point meeting M*'s criterion (retune); in-sample points are descriptive

B_literature_form.validity_rule: HK1 and HK1c on PD7, SD1_7 and PD, identical for M* and every comparator (R15 m3)

all_arm_contrast_descriptive.note: descriptive only: Z0 and the sweep arms are never comparators

d14_forms.note: D14 v04 section 6: reported for the researcher's decision; nothing is gated on nuScenes

joint_loss.rule: Form B validity (D14 v05 section 6 (i)) applied to the joint loss: for each of PD7, SD1_7 and PD the scene-level V2 (per scene, the share of its decisions with a relied record in the population that have >= 1 exceedance; then the mean over scenes) must be evaluable (>= 39 scenes from >= 8 logs), not flagged (A.flag: one-sided 0.95 log-cluster bootstrap lower bound > delta, or est > delta when the bootstrap SE is zero) and its one-sided 0.95 upper bound must be <= delta + 0.03 (HK1c). The same rule for M*J, M* and every comparator. HK1a's per-stratum cell family has no analogue (a decision's union spans strata), so the test is HK1b and HK1c on the pooled joint loss.

MstarJ.rule: Form B validity (D14 v05 section 6 (i)) applied to the joint loss: for each of PD7, SD1_7 and PD the scene-level V2 (per scene, the share of its decisions with a relied record in the population that have >= 1 exceedance; then the mean over scenes) must be evaluable (>= 39 scenes from >= 8 logs), not flagged (A.flag: one-sided 0.95 log-cluster bootstrap lower bound > delta, or est > delta when the bootstrap SE is zero) and its one-sided 0.95 upper bound must be <= delta + 0.03 (HK1c). The same rule for M*J, M* and every comparator. HK1a's per-stratum cell family has no analogue (a decision's union spans strata), so the test is HK1b and HK1c on the pooled joint loss.

MstarJx.rule: Form B validity (D14 v05 section 6 (i)) applied to the joint loss: for each of PD7, SD1_7 and PD the scene-level V2 (per scene, the share of its decisions with a relied record in the population that have >= 1 exceedance; then the mean over scenes) must be evaluable (>= 39 scenes from >= 8 logs), not flagged (A.flag: one-sided 0.95 log-cluster bootstrap lower bound > delta, or est > delta when the bootstrap SE is zero) and its one-sided 0.95 upper bound must be <= delta + 0.03 (HK1c). The same rule for M*J, M* and every comparator. HK1a's per-stratum cell family has no analogue (a decision's union spans strata), so the test is HK1b and HK1c on the pooled joint loss.

MstarJ.note: paired at identical decision states; scene-level means; log-cluster bootstrap

MstarJx.note: paired at identical decision states; scene-level means; log-cluster bootstrap

fit.stamp: DEV MODE: the 10 development scenes; plumbing only, not evidence (K8 joint arm M*J)
fit.stratification: one scalar lambda per tracker and fold, shared by all 96 L0 strata x 2 in-path parts and the 4 calibrated steps, multiplying M*'s per-stratum thresholds (MstarJ) or the same rule's 3-fold refit (MstarJx); steps 2.5-4 s unchanged

counts.dev_scenes_excluded: development run: the development scenes ARE the data (none excluded)
notes: Transductive scope: the K7 fits are cross-fitted on 5 log folds of the same 850 nuScenes trainval scenes; the evaluation scenes are the 840 non-development scenes, held out of their own fold's fit but not of the design (K7 plan section 13).
CANMOT-SC (T1) was tuned on nuScenes val by its authors; its detections and tracks on val are not independent of that tuning.
The tracker does not run in the loop: the recorded tracker output is replayed from the logged ego (D14 v04 section 2).
Each population is tested at 0.95 with no Bonferroni split across the three populations (R15 m2: the stricter choice for a no-flag test).
Backed-off decisions are scored at the full margin in V1 / V2 (PD7's inherited selection); V2_exec scores the executed margin lam * margin (R15 m9).
